title: Lox meat

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Lox meat is a basic food obtained by killing Lox. It can be cooked directly on an Iron cooking station, but not on a wooden Cooking station, to obtain Cooked lox meat, or Coal if overcooked. It is used directly in food recipes at the Food preparation table.

sections.heading: Crafting
sections.text:
• Cooked lox meat
• Coal, if left on an Iron cooking station for too long
• Lox meat pie (from Unbaked lox pie)
• Meat platter (from Uncooked meat platter)
Cooked lox meat cannot be used to craft recipes using Lox meat as ingredient.
